description: An object element's value can't continue on the next line at the element's top level
notes: The prose says newlines between the braces of an object constructor are ignored as whitespace. hashicorp/hcl makes newlines significant inside object constructors, so an operand of a value expression can't be on the next line unless it is inside a nested construct that ignores newlines, such as parentheses or brackets (parseObjectCons in hclsyntax/parser.go).
